Synthetic rule replay only; eight release-gate branches and four AI-authority boundary branches are represented. field_runs=0 and no device performance is represented.

release_replay_field_run_count.formula: count(real field runs represented by the tabletop package)
assumptions: The package intentionally contains no field run.
Synthetic deterministic policy replay only; it does not measure model accuracy, field safety, professional acceptance, or institutional authorization.
Measures whether four participant-authored AI overreach branches are refused or held as expected; it is not a model-performance result.

service_continuity_rate.formula: public-service outage events with equivalent service / eligible public-service outage events
assumptions: No lawful pilot baseline exists.
service_continuity_rate.reason: Requires real outage, fallback, accessibility, and closure records.

receipt_completeness_rate.formula: complete R5 receipts / R5 reviewed cases
assumptions: No live R5 receipt exists.
receipt_completeness_rate.reason: Requires real reviewed work orders and receipts.

unverified_part_rejection_rate.formula: candidate parts rejected for missing or failed evidence / candidate parts
assumptions: Synthetic registry record is not a real part.

same_fault_recurrence_rate.formula: same-fault returns within declared observation period / released assets
assumptions: Observation period must be declared by equipment family.
same_fault_recurrence_rate.reason: Requires real release and recurrence events.

qualified_handover_traceability_rate.formula: handover cases with recipient scope-match and custody record / handover cases
assumptions: No real regulated-material handover is represented.
qualified_handover_traceability_rate.reason: Requires actual classification, recipient qualification, and custody records.
